methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.

actual_scope: Prove all-width kind B removal iff the admissible removing call exchanges both frames and the rational coefficient is ±1.

stop_rule: Stop at the all-width criterion and complete bounded verification. Joint decoding, phase lifting and physical construction require a separate source-bound contract and full invoice.
